title: 第十一章 幻痛自曝暗影身份第十二章 幻痛枷锁人格拉扯
slug: 星冕天启守护者觉醒录
lines: 暗紫色的虚空余雾还残留在暗影宫殿的穹顶边角，未曾彻底散尽。
方才那场颠覆三年执念、撕碎所有信仰的隐秘对话，如同无数根淬了寒霜的细针，密密麻麻扎进紫苑梦绪的神魂深处，穿透了她三年层层伪装的麻木外壳，刺破了她被暗黑禁术死死禁锢的本心囚笼。
她缓步从阴影死角走出，每一步踏在冰凉通透的暗晶地砖之上，都清晰听见鞋底触碰石材的清寂声响。这声响落在死寂肃穆的大殿之中，平淡无奇，却在她翻崩离析的心底掀起万丈惊涛。
外人眼中，此刻的她依旧是那个恭顺谦卑、麻木寡言、唯暗樱女王之命是从的直属影侍。周身暗影灵力收敛得滴水不漏，眉眼低垂、神色淡然，身姿挺拔规矩，一举一动皆是三年如一日的标准姿态，找不出半分异常、半分破绽。
无人知晓，这具被黑暗戾气浸染三年、被复仇执念捆绑三年的傀儡躯壳之内，早已天崩地裂、满目疮痍。
支撑她熬过禁术噬神之痛、熬过孤身黑暗孤寂、熬过无尽杀戮罪孽的唯一执念轰然崩塌，那些扎根神魂的恨意、偏执、隐忍与坚守，在知晓全部骗局的瞬间，尽数化作刺骨的荒诞与悲凉。
三年效忠奔赴、浴血征战、忍辱负重、以身饲暗，原来从来都不是为了清算背叛、抚平伤痕，从来都没有半分苦尽甘来的期许。
她只是一枚精心挑选、刻意培养、用完即弃的棋子，一件榨干价值、便可碾碎神魂的工具。
暗樱女王端坐于悬浮虚空的暗纹玄石王座之上，华贵恢弘的暗樱玄黑龙纹长袍铺满王座四周，紫金流转的暗黑神纹在衣身缓缓游走，裹挟着碾压整片暗影疆域的至高威压。她慵懒倚靠扶手，修长指尖轻捻一缕幽暗紫芒，淡漠的视线自上而下落向缓步走来的紫苑梦绪，深邃冷冽的眼眸藏着看透一切的掌控算计，没有丝毫温度，没有半分悲悯。
在这位黑暗君主的眼中，眼前的影侍依旧是那个被执念牢牢桎梏、被虚假承诺死死拿捏、永远温顺可控、永远忠心不二的利刃。
她方才对朝雾白莲的一番剖白，自以为隔绝完美、无人窥探，自以为这场跨越三年的骗局天衣无缝、永久隐秘。她笃定，深陷复仇执念的紫苑梦绪永远不会觉醒、永远不会识破、永远不会生出半分叛离之心。
“梦绪，此次人间学园全域暗影动乱，战局细节、守护者战力变化、战队破绽短板，一一报备。”
暗樱女王的声音低沉淡漠，带着上位者独有的威严冷肃，平淡的语调听不出任何情绪，只是例行公事般的问询，是三年来从未改变的复命流程。
紫苑梦绪垂首伫立，长长的睫毛轻轻覆下，遮住了眼底早已彻底更迭的心神。
曾经覆满紫灰幻雾、迷离偏执、冰冷空洞的眼眸，此刻雾色尽数褪去，内里是一片历经崩塌、彻底清醒、极致沉静的漠然，沉静之下，藏着无人窥见、至死不悔的决绝。
她维持着影侍最恭顺的姿态，嗓音平稳清冷，没有一丝颤抖，精准规整地将此前学园战场的所有情报缓缓道出。

“回女王，本次琉光星冕学园暗影袭扰全域完成，全程试探光明守护者全员战力输出、联动配合、防御短板。天野凛星冰光战力稳定，单兵突袭爆发力极强，统筹全队战术沉稳无漏，是战队核心主力与战术支点。藤咲若织远程狙击精准度极高，草木红莲双系灵力攻防兼备，治愈结界构筑速度极快，可随时补足战队防御缺口与伤势损耗。海月涟音水风双系控场稳定，群体防御结界覆盖范围广，全员治愈能力极强，极大提升战队持续作战能力。琉璃金朵土金增益护盾完整，丝线束缚控场精准，团战辅助续航无可替代。四人战队联动默契极高，攻防互补、进退有序，无明显致命破绽。本次袭扰未伤及核心战力，仅小幅消耗光明灵力，顺利完成初步战力试探任务。”
一字一句，条理清晰、精准客观、毫无纰漏，完美复刻了往日复命的模样。
她刻意隐去了自己战场放水、刻意收敛绝杀战力、刻意放弃猎杀契机、纵容光明战队圆满收官的所有细节，如同过往无数次任务报备一般，将自己的所有私心动摇、所有温柔纵容彻底掩埋。
只是此刻的隐瞒，早已不再是为了隐忍蛰伏、等待复仇，而是为了挣脱枷锁、逃离掌控、奔赴新生。
暗樱女王静静听着，指尖流转的暗紫光丝微微一顿，深邃的眼眸微微眯起，锐利的目光牢牢锁在紫苑梦绪的身上，带着极致精准、极致多疑的探查审视。
活了千年、执掌黑暗生杀大权的她，对麾下每一位影侍的气息波动、心神状态、情绪变化都了如指掌。
纵然紫苑梦绪伪装得天衣无缝，纵然她的语气、姿态、神态与往日别无二致，可暗樱女王依旧敏锐捕捉到了那一丝极其细微、截然不同的变化。
她身上盘踞三年、浓烈刺骨、执念深重的黑暗戾气，淡了。
那是扎根神魂、由复仇恨意催生、由暗黑禁术滋养的戾气，三年日夜萦绕、从未消减分毫，是紫苑梦绪最鲜明的标记、最稳固的枷锁。可此刻，这份深入骨髓的偏执戾气悄然褪去，取而代之的是一种空洞沉寂、挣脱束缚后的清冷通透。
她的气息依旧冰冷，却少了往日裹挟的疯狂恨意；她的姿态依旧恭顺，却少了扎根心底的卑微隐忍。
看似一模一样的傀儡皮囊，内里的心绪与信念，已然彻底颠覆。
这份细微的变化，旁人无从察觉，却逃不过暗樱女王洞悉一切的双眼。
王座之上的女人眼底掠过一抹极淡的幽暗寒芒，算计的心思飞速流转。
她太清楚紫苑梦绪的软肋与根基，太清楚这枚棋子的所有牵绊。
她靠着复仇执念存活，靠着恨意支撑战力，靠着对光明的憎恨厮杀三年。一旦执念动摇、恨意消退，这柄为黑暗而生的利刃，便会彻底失去掌控、失去用途、失去原本的价值。
绝对不能容许。
她耗费三年光阴、耗费无数暗黑神力滋养培育的顶级本源，绝不能在即将大局落定的关键时刻，出现半分偏差、半分失控。
紫苑梦绪的动摇，是隐患，是破绽，是必须立刻扼杀、彻底肃清的变数。
暗樱女王面上依旧维持着淡漠慵懒的神色，不露半分猜忌与阴鸷，语气依旧平缓威严，淡淡开口。
“此次试探尚可，光明战队根基稳固、联动极强，仅凭常规袭扰难以破局。既然你近日潜伏人间、与一众守护者朝夕相处，对他们的战术习惯、作战风格、攻防套路最为熟悉，那哀家便给你一道新的指令。”
紫苑梦绪垂首静立，心神沉静无波，静静等待她的下文。
她已然猜到，这位多疑狠戾的女王，定然察觉到了她的异样，定然不会任由她的心神异动肆意蔓延。
“即刻重返人间琉光星冕学园，全程开启堕幻影侍完全战斗形态。”
暗樱女王语调骤然冷沉，不容置喙的暗黑威压轰然落定，牢牢禁锢整片大殿空域。
“无需收敛战力、无需保留余地、无需刻意试探，以紫苑梦绪的暗影真身，正面硬撼星冕天启守护者全员。全力开战、强行破局、倾力杀伐，以绝对战力压制四人，击溃他们的联动阵型、摧毁他们的作战心态、重创他们的光明灵力。”
字字冰冷、句句强硬，没有丝毫转圜余地。
“哀家要你亲手斩断所有暧昧牵绊、亲手碾碎所有动摇心思、亲手抹杀心底残存的所有柔软。用你与光明守护者的生死血战，证明你的忠诚，稳固你的本心，彻底掐灭你所有异动的念头。”
这便是暗樱女王最阴狠、最擅长的掌控手段。
她清晰知晓，潜伏人间的这些时日，紫苑梦绪以普通学生夜见幽弥的身份，与天野凛星、藤咲若织、海月涟音、琉璃金朵朝夕相伴、温柔相处。
content_en:
The dark purple void mist still lingers on the corners of the dome of the Shadow Palace and has not completely dissipated.
The secret conversation just now that subverted three years of obsession and tore apart all beliefs was like countless thin needles tempered with frost, densely piercing into the depths of Ziyuan Mengxu's soul, penetrating the numb shell she had been pretending for three years, and piercing the cage of her heart that was tightly imprisoned by the dark forbidden art.
She walked slowly out of the shadowed corner, and with every step she took on the cold and transparent dark crystal floor tiles, she could clearly hear the quiet sound of her soles touching the stone. The sound fell into the dead silence and solemn hall. It was unremarkable, but it set off a huge storm in her heart.
In the eyes of outsiders, at this moment, she was still the humble, insensitive and taciturn Shadow Attendant who only followed the orders of Queen Dark Sakura. The shadow spiritual energy all over his body is tightly restrained, his eyebrows are lowered, his expression is indifferent, his posture is upright and regular, and every move he makes is a standard posture that he has been doing for three years, without any abnormalities or flaws.
No one knew that the body of this puppet, which had been soaked in darkness and hostility for three years and bound by the obsession for revenge for three years, had already been shattered and devastated.
The only obsession that supported her through the pain of the forbidden art, the darkness and loneliness, and the endless killing sins suddenly collapsed. The hatred, paranoia, tolerance and perseverance that had taken root in her soul turned into bone-chilling absurdity and sadness the moment she knew the whole scam.
Three years of loyal service, bloody battles, enduring humiliation, and risking one's life in darkness. It turned out that it was never for the purpose of settling betrayals and healing wounds, and there was never any hope that all the hardships would be rewarded.
She is just a carefully selected, deliberately cultivated, disposable chess piece, a tool that can squeeze out the value and crush the soul.
The Queen of Dark Sakura sits on a dark stone throne suspended in the void. The luxurious and magnificent Dark Sakura Black Dragon Pattern robes are spread around the throne. Dark divine patterns flowing in purple and gold slowly roam around the body, carrying the supreme pressure that crushes the entire shadow territory. She leaned lazily on the armrest, gently twirling a wisp of dark purple light with her long fingertips, and her indifferent eyes fell from top to bottom towards Ziyuan Mengxu, who was walking slowly. Her deep and cold eyes hid the control and calculation that could see through everything, without any warmth or any compassion.
In the eyes of this dark lord, the Shadow Attendant in front of him is still the sharp blade that is firmly shackled by obsession, controlled by false promises, always docile and controllable, and always loyal.
She had just confessed to Asogiri Bailian. She thought that she was completely isolated and no one was prying. She thought that the scam that spanned three years was seamless and always secret. She was certain that Shion Mengxu, who was deeply obsessed with revenge, would never awaken, never see through, and never have any feelings of betrayal.
"Mengxu, this shadow turmoil in the entire Human World Academy, the details of the battle situation, changes in the guardian's combat power, and the team's weaknesses and shortcomings, please report them one by one."
Queen Dark Sakura's voice was low and indifferent, with the unique majesty and coldness of a superior. Her plain tone contained no emotion. It was just a routine inquiry. It was a rebirth process that had not changed in the past three years.
Ziyuan Mengxu stood with her head lowered, her long eyelashes gently covering her eyes, hiding the completely changed mind under her eyes.
The eyes that were once covered with purple-gray phantom fog, blurred paranoia, and cold and empty eyes, now all the fog has faded away, and inside is a piece of indifference that has experienced collapse, is completely awake, and is extremely quiet. Under the silence, there is a determination that no one can see and will never regret until death.
She maintained the most submissive posture of the Shadow Attendant, her voice was smooth and cold, without a trace of tremor, and she slowly and accurately stated all the information about the previous battlefield in the academy.
"Back to the Queen, this time the Shadow Raid of Ryukou Star Mian Academy has been completed, and the whole process has tested the combat power output, linkage cooperation, and defensive shortcomings of all the Guardians of Light. Amano Rinxei Ice Light has stable combat power, and the explosive power of single-soldier raids is extremely strong, and he coordinates the entire team Tactics are stable and flawless, and he is the core force and tactical fulcrum of the team. Fujisaki Wakaori has extremely high accuracy in long-range sniping. He has dual-system spiritual power in both offense and defense. Healing barrier construction is very fast, and he can make up for the team's defense gaps and injuries at any time. Consumption. Haiyue Lianyin, water and wind dual systems have stable field control, the group defense barrier has a wide coverage, and the healing ability of all members is extremely strong, which greatly improves the team's continuous combat ability. The Liuli Jinduo Earth Gold buff shield is complete, and the silk thread restraint has accurate field control, making team battles more effective. The auxiliary battery life is irreplaceable. The four-person team has a high level of coordination, complements each other in attack and defense, and has an orderly advance and retreat. There are no obvious fatal flaws in the attack, and only a small amount of light spiritual energy has been consumed, and the initial combat power test mission has been successfully completed."
Word by word, it is clear, precise, objective, and flawless, perfectly replicating the appearance of the past.
She deliberately concealed all the details of her escapades on the battlefield, deliberately restrained her killing power, deliberately gave up hunting opportunities, and connived at the successful conclusion of the Light Team. Just like countless mission reports in the past, she completely buried all her selfish motives and all her tenderness and indulgence.
It's just that the concealment at this moment is no longer for the sake of tolerance and dormancy, waiting for revenge, but for the purpose of breaking free from the shackles, escaping from control, and rushing to new life.
Queen Dark Sakura listened quietly, the dark purple light flowing through her fingertips paused slightly, her deep eyes narrowed slightly, her sharp gaze firmly locked on Shion Mengxu's body, with extremely precise and extremely suspicious exploration and inspection.
Having lived for thousands of years and holding the power of life and death in the dark, she is well aware of the aura fluctuations, mental states, and emotional changes of every shadow server under her command.
Even though Shion Mengxu's disguise was perfect, even though her tone, posture, and demeanor were the same as before, Queen Anzakura was still keenly aware of the extremely subtle and completely different changes.
The strong, biting, and obsessive dark anger that had lingered in her body for three years had faded away.
It was a violent energy rooted in the soul, spawned by revenge and hatred, and nourished by dark forbidden arts. It lingered day and night for three years and never diminished at all. It was the most distinctive mark and the most stable shackle of Ziyuan Mengxu. But at this moment, the paranoia and hostility deep in the bone marrow quietly faded away, replaced by an empty silence, a cold and transparent feeling after breaking free from the restraints.
Her breath was still cold, but it lacked the crazy hatred that she used to have; her posture was still submissive, but it lacked the humble forbearance that took root deep in her heart.
The seemingly identical puppet skin, but the mood and beliefs inside have been completely overturned.
This subtle change cannot be noticed by others, but it cannot escape the all-seeing eyes of Queen Dark Sakura.
A faint dark cold light flashed across the eyes of the woman on the throne, and her calculating thoughts were flowing rapidly.
She is too aware of Shion Mengxu's weaknesses and foundation, and is too aware of all the ties to this chess piece.
She relied on her obsession with revenge to survive, relied on her hatred to support her fighting strength, and relied on her hatred of the light to fight for three years. Once the obsession shakes and the hatred fades, this sharp blade born for darkness will completely lose control, use and original value.
Absolutely not allowed.
The top-level origin that she spent three years and countless dark divine power nourishing and cultivating must not be even half-way deviated or out of control at the critical moment when the overall situation is about to be settled.
Shion Mengxu's wavering is a hidden danger, a flaw, and a variable that must be eliminated immediately and completely eliminated.
Queen Dark Sakura still maintained an indifferent and lazy look on her face, showing no trace of suspicion or scheming. Her tone was still calm and majestic, and she spoke calmly.
"This test is acceptable. The Light Team has a solid foundation and strong linkage. It is difficult to break the situation with just regular harassment. Since you have been lurking in the world recently, living with a group of guardians day and night, and are most familiar with their tactical habits, combat styles, and offensive and defensive routines, the Ai family will give you a new order."
Ziyuan Mengxu stood quietly with her head bowed, her mind calm and unruffled, quietly waiting for her next words.
She had already guessed that this suspicious and cruel queen must have noticed something strange about her and would not let her strange thoughts spread uncontrollably.
"Immediately return to the world of Glazed Star Mian Academy and activate the full combat form of the Fallen Phantom Shadow Warrior."
Queen Dark Sakura's tone suddenly became cold, and the dark pressure that could not be ignored suddenly settled down, firmly confining the entire airspace of the hall.
"There is no need to restrain combat power, no need to reserve any room, no need to deliberately test, use the shadow true form of Shion Mengxu to challenge all the guardians of the Star Crown Apocalypse head-on. Start the war with all your strength, forcefully break the situation, and kill with all your strength. Use absolute combat power to suppress the four of them, defeat their joint formation, destroy their combat mentality, and severely damage their bright spiritual power."
Every word is cold, every sentence is strong, and there is no room for change.
"The Aijia wants you to personally cut off all the ambiguous ties, personally crush all the wavering thoughts, and personally wipe out all the remaining softness in your heart. Use your life-and-death bloody battle with the guardian of light to prove your loyalty, stabilize your true heart, and completely eliminate all your thoughts of abnormality."
This is Queen Dark Sakura's most vicious and adept control method.
She clearly knew that during these days of hiding in the human world, Shion Yumeo, as an ordinary student Yami Yuya, accompanied and lived tenderly with Amano Rinxei, Fujisaki Wakaori, Kaiyue Renyin, and Liuli Jinduo day and night.
